about: Secret-scanner rule data shared by the ledger (src/secrets.mjs, Node) and the latent runtime's gateway (runtime/latent_team/secret_scan.py, Python): cards P4b, P4c and W2. Both read this file, so a rule changes in one place; rules/secret-conformance.json holds the cases both test suites run against each side's scanner. Patterns use the subset both regex engines read alike: Python compiles them with re.ASCII (word boundaries and case folding are ASCII-only, as JavaScript's word boundary is) and matches the anchored ones with fullmatch. Offsets in the conformance cases count code points.

simple.about: A pattern that recognises where a value starts, the class of characters the value then runs on (null: none), an anchored pattern whose match is the public prefix that may be shown, and optionally mixedAfter: the value from that index on must hold a letter and a digit.

values.about: A value after a name: the lead (case-insensitive) ends where the value begins; the value runs on cls, or to its closing quote, and must match accept.

freeText.about: Card P4c: after one of these leads (case-insensitive) the rest of the line is the value. The assigned-secret lead is built from nameKeywords as: \b(?:[A-Za-z0-9]{1,32}[_.-])?(?:KEYWORDS)\b["']?[ \t]*[:=][ \t]* with KEYWORDS the list joined by |.

placeholders.about: A free-text value that is only a stand-in for a secret, judged on the whole value. flags i is case-insensitive. An angle-bracket value is a stand-in when it matches angleStandIn and one of its words (split by spaces, underscores or hyphens) is in standInWords.
